messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.21-2
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (1.21-2) has been released at its web site
(http://www.rqtl.org) and on CRAN.

There are only minor changes; the new release is to deal with an
upcoming change in R.  See http://www.rqtl.org/STATUS.txt for a list
of changes.

Karl Broman
kbr...@biostat.wisc.edu
